final_text: {"proposed_outcome":"ESCALATE","findings":[{"text":"The event is an upload action.","evidence_id":"EVENT"},{"text":"The destination is a personal cloud-storage account on dropbox.com.","evidence_id":"DESTINATION"},{"text":"The file is classified Internal with high confidence.","evidence_id":"CLASSIFICATION"},{"text":"User behavior is elevated and includes a new destination signal.","evidence_id":"BEHAVIOR"},{"text":"Policy review is currently in conflict status with unknown effect.","evidence_id":"POLICY"},{"text":"The Data Loss Prevention Policy states that uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1"},{"text":"The Acceptable Use Policy states that employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E2"},{"text":"The Data Loss Prevention Policy states that a business need conflicting with the policy requires a DLP exception request approved through the exception process.","evidence_id":"E4"},{"text":"No approved DLP exception was found for this user and destination.","evidence_id":"EXCEPTION"},{"text":"Recent activity shows zero external uploads in the last 7 days.","evidence_id":"ACTIVITY"}],"missing_evidence":[]}
